status_at_declaration: Analytical proposal only; no R7 simulations executed
proposal: Under the unchanged historical symbiotic norm, place +d at x and -d at x+d, with zero exterior. Each source first copies onto its partner's old position and then uses that partner's value to copy in the opposite direction. Predicted first children start at x-d and x+d. This is a designed initial condition, not an evolved organism or a novel rule.

primary_basis.scope: Historical helper rule; this dyad construction and assay are research extensions. No claim this case was a published figure.

interventions.positive_removed: Set x to zero; remove exactly one occupied cell.
interventions.negative_removed: Set x+d to zero; remove exactly one occupied cell. Symmetric damage size; this two-cell founder has no dispensable internal cell.
interventions.wrong_negative_same_occupancy: Replace -d at x+d by -(d+1); keep occupied positions.
interventions.composition_shuffled_fixed_gaps: Swap +d and -d; preserve occupied positions and multiset.
interventions.spacing_shift: Move -d from x+d to x+d+1; preserve values and cell count.
interventions.rescue: Restore removed -d at its exact original position before t0.
interventions.background_matched_damage: Three additional construction controls place unrelated -4 at x400, outside the 12-update dyad interaction cone: background intact, focal -4 removed, unrelated -4 removed. Matches removed value and count without asserting a dispensable internal component.
interventions.helpers_disabled_oracle: Oracle-only rule intervention: suppress recursion, retain first copy, order and boundaries. Save the numerical history; do not label this the historical norm.
interventions.child_isolation: Extract each exact first child, clear exterior cells, translate to x240 in W512. Separately test one traced update and 12-update reproduction/persistence. Isolation is imposed; original branching arises from declared dynamics.

evidence_requirements: At t1, two exact translated footprints with two empty exterior cells and unchanged R6 exclusive full-founder copying criteria, internal helper paths and no external or unknown roots.
Ordered trace reconstructs every one-update value. A separately written first-step audit checks four predicted copying edges and two helper uses without importing R6 lineage propagation.
Uninstrumented harness includes Taylor's unchanged source and calls original update functions. Every R7 native history must match this separate binary cell for cell.
Component deletion, wrong-value, shuffle and spacing changes cannot pass first-step reproduction. Rescue restores all native numbers and ordered events.
Unrelated same-value deletion retains branching; helpers-disabled counterfactual loses it.
Both first children from each intact setting reproduce after isolation and retain exact footprints through the recovery horizon.
All three reserved settings and longer horizon are reported regardless of outcome; deterministic robustness cases, not independent population samples.
trace_scope: Complete traces and unchanged R6 analysis on one-update native runs. Matched continuation runs use trace_steps=0: numerical matching and reference replay only beyond t1. Interior helper cycles reach the historical width cap; full repeated stacks would waste disk. Do not claim long-horizon cell ancestry.

budgets.oracle_compute: One unchanged-source replay per native run; additionally one helpers-disabled continuation per intact setting. Count separately.
budgets.execution: Serial CPU-only, resumable hash checks. No random campaign or estimate of search-method advantage.

limits: A dyad is a distributed two-cell footprint. Its internal gap equals the gap between adjacent children. Partition is operational, not evidence of organism boundaries or independent later interaction.
Each cell alone translates and persists but cannot increase its count here. Assistance concerns pair copying, not individual survival.

An expanding regular lattice is expected. First-step detached copies plus isolation assays test numerical copying capacity, not life, biological symbiosis, inherited diversity or open-ended evolution.
Constructed calibration cannot reverse R6's negative findings for its historical and generated motifs.
model_use: One conversational Codex construction based on saved R6 failures and historical source. No new external model API call or paid service; exact serving-model tokens unavailable.
